status_summary: On 2025-07-10 HUD and OMB announced the end of policies introduced under the PAVE task force, effectively disbanding it, and terminated three FHA mortgagee letters on appraisal review, reconsideration of value and appraiser fair housing compliance (ML 2024-16, ML 2024-07 and ML 2021-27). Those policies had first been rescinded on 2025-03-19 through Mortgagee Letter 2025-08. HUD stated that the Fair Housing Act and the Equal Credit Opportunity Act continue to be enforced. A HUD notice published 2026-07-17 (91 FR 44867) withdrew 13 Office of General Counsel guidance documents, including the 2022 appraisal elements of proof guidance, effective 2025-09-25.

timeline.event: HUD Mortgagee Letter 2025-08 rescinded appraisal-related mortgagee letters for FHA single family programs.
